touring-server/src/server.rs.purpose: Main MCP server implementation. 26 tools via rmcp SDK macros (#[tool_router] + #[tool]). Manages TouringServer struct with 17 Arc<Mutex<>> fields. Handles AST, memory, learning, graph, session, decompose, evolve, suggest, refactor, mask, mcts, speculate, online_learn tools. Spawns 3 background tasks (JSONL watcher, evolution engine, symbol refresh).
problems: CRITICAL: Cyclomatic complexity CC=27 in new(), CC=21 in ast_find(), CC=11 in ast_overview() — exceeds CC<=10 threshold
God object anti-pattern: TouringServer has 17 fields all behind Arc<Mutex<>>, single struct owns all state
Background task in spawn_background_tasks() runs external Python script (touring_bootstrap_symbols.py) without timeout — can hang indefinitely
tool_name_to_action() uses djb2 hash % 64 — collision risk for action ID mapping
suggest_next_tool_simple() is #[allow(dead_code)] — unused but not removed
Duplicate graph_hotspots code between evolve/extract_patterns and decompose/validate_order (DRY violation)
memory_recall total_matches calculation is confusing: adds rlm_json.len().saturating_sub(result.rlm_matches.len()) which is always 0
improvements: Split TouringServer into sub-routers per domain (AST, Memory, Learning, Graph) using rmcp router composition
Extract graph_hotspots into a shared GraphService method
Add timeout to Python script execution in spawn_background_tasks()
Replace djb2 hash with a proper bijective mapping for tool→action

touring-server/src/tools/mod.rs.purpose: Tool module registry. Declares 7 sub-modules (ast, file, project, memory, learning, utility, hook). Contains 4 structural tests validating tool count (26), module existence, public API presence, and hooks crate independence.

touring-server/src/tools/ast_tools.rs.purpose: AST symbol extraction, find, diff, blast radius tools. Uses touring-ast for tree-sitter parsing. Supports Python/Rust/TypeScript/JavaScript. Contains AstOverviewTool, AstFindArgs, BlastRadiusArgs.

touring_ast_find creates a NEW SymbolIndex per call — does not reuse the server's persistent index
improvements: Remove dead parser_pool field or integrate it
Extract language parsing to a shared helper
Wire ast_find to use the persistent SymbolStore for cross-call symbol persistence

Actually implement async I/O in handle_async instead of delegating to sync

integration_issues.issue: Inconsistent state/action ID mapping between server.rs and cortex learning handler
integration_issues.detail: server.rs uses djb2_hash % 64 for tool→action, cortex/handlers/learning.rs uses explicit match table (Read=0, Write=1, etc.). QTable entries written by one system are misinterpreted by the other.
cortex/handlers/learning.rs opens raw rusqlite::Connection to rlm_memory.db instead of using the LearningPersistence API, creating fragile coupling to DB schema.

integration_issues.issue: FileKnowledgeDB is !Sync but shared across Arc
integration_issues.detail: Multiple #[allow(clippy::arc_with_non_send_sync)] annotations in runtime.rs and neural handlers. Safe only because CLI model is single-threaded — will break if concurrency is added.

integration_issues.issue: ast_tools::touring_ast_find creates ephemeral SymbolIndex per call
integration_issues.detail: Does not use the server's persistent SymbolStore/SymbolIndex. Each find call re-indexes the provided files from scratch.
spawn_background_tasks() calls touring_bootstrap_symbols.py via tokio::process::Command without any timeout. Script failure or hang blocks the symbol refresh loop forever.
